caught_by: instrument control set (5 rows with grants known from p798)
symptom: NA_no_licence_file on 5 repos with known grants
root_cause: git ls-tree -l puts size in field 4 and name in field 5; the instrument read the name from field 4
fix: read name from $5 and size from $4

caught_by: control row asistente-docente-sin-conexion, which p798 had graded GPL-3.0
symptom: AGPL-3.0 at 35,149 B where p798 read GPL-3.0
root_cause: GPL-3.0 section 13 is titled Use with the GNU Affero General Public License, so a whole-body matcher flips the family
fix: classify on the title line (first 5 lines)

caught_by: reading this base's own p214 ledger after the fact
symptom: the mechanism was already named correctly ~585 passes earlier
root_cause: the knowledge lived in a prose ledger, not in a shared classifier
fix: ACTION p799-H: one shared classifier with two committed controls

caught_by: internal inconsistency - verdict LATAM with signal NA_none
symptom: OpenDidactia (Madrid/Galicia/Andalucia) graded LATAM; rebuild-choco graded LATAM for the wrong token
root_cause: ENEM is a substring of the Spanish tenemos; INEP is a substring of camelCase ...lineP...
fix: acronyms matched case-sensitively with word boundaries; verdict carries its token

caught_by: control row OpenDidactia after the cycle-3 fix
root_cause: Paraguay ccTLD .py is the Python file extension; .cl is Chile and OpenCL; .es is Spain and ECMAScript
fix: a ccTLD is accepted only inside a URL host

defect: country name in an i18n locale list
symptom: LATAM:brazil on a Chinese university repository
root_cause: README line 887 is an i18n locale list: Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Mexico)
fix: locale and language lines removed before the country scan; APAC institution class added

caught_by: full control battery - all 7 rows went to unresolved at once
symptom: every region signal empty on rows that had resolved a moment earlier
root_cause: sed y/// requires source and destination of equal BYTE length; a multibyte source errored and command substitution returned empty
fix: reverted; accented forms handled in the pattern instead

defect: trailing word boundary after a multibyte letter
caught_by: control row yachay-wasi, whose description names Peru
symptom: Peru in a description never matched
root_cause: grep runs byte-oriented in this session, so \b after the two bytes of u-acute can never hold
fix: accented country forms matched outside the bounded group

defect: published TSV had no header row
caught_by: publication gate - column-count check read row 1 as the header
symptom: 8 data rows reported as cols=7 rows=7
root_cause: the header echo was not piped into tee, so column labels never reached the file
fix: header prepended, then artefact regenerated with headers inside the writer

defect: placeholder value in a published column
caught_by: publication gate - scan for placeholder tokens
symptom: p135_reimpl_verdict read pending on all 8 rows
root_cause: the column was written before the comparison it reports was computed
fix: filled with TEMPLATE_MATCH / MODIFIED_SUPERSET from the clause md5

defect: byte count one low, and it changed a headline
root_cause: command substitution strips the trailing newline, so wc -c under-counts by 1
fix: re-measured from ls-tree; p795-A band false-alarm corrected from 6 of 8 to 5 of 8
